items.source: texts - An array of strings for the model to embed. For optimal performance, we recommend reducing the length of each text to less than 512 tokens. 1 token is about 4 characters.
items.translation: texts - 模型用于嵌入的字符串数组。为获得最佳性能，建议将每个文本的长度减少到 512 个令牌以下。1 个令牌大约相当于 4 个字符。

items.source: inputType - Prepends special tokens to differentiate each type from one another. You should not mix different types together, except when mixing types for search and retrieval. In this case, embed your corpus with the search_document type and embedded queries with type search_query type.
items.translation: inputType - 在开头添加特殊标记以区分不同类型。您不应混合使用不同类型的输入，除非是在搜索和检索场景下。在这种情况下，请将语料库嵌入为 search_document 类型，将查询嵌入为 search_query 类型。

items.source: truncate - Specifies how the API handles inputs longer than the maximum token length. If you specify LEFT or RIGHT, the model discards the input until the remaining input is exactly the maximum input token length for the model.
items.translation: truncate - 指定 API 如何处理超过最大令牌长度的输入。如果您指定 LEFT 或 RIGHT，模型将丢弃输入，直到剩余输入恰好等于模型的最大输入令牌长度。
